<meta content="YGO — программа по YouTube, личному бренду, продуктам и продажам. Построй личный бренд и начни зарабатывать $15 000 на своих продуктах и услугах с помощью YouTube за 180 дней." name="description"/>

/* YGO interactive income backdrop: all 130 images are part of the page background, not a gallery. */
.screen--case{isolation:isolate}
.screen--case > .shell{position:relative;z-index:1}
.screen--case .income-wall{position:fixed;inset:78px 0 95px;overflow:hidden;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:#090707}
.income-wall-tracks{position:absolute;inset:-30px -6%;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;transform:rotate(-3deg) scale(1.15);transform-origin:center center;animation:income-vertical 64s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.income-wall-row{display:flex;gap:12px;width:max-content;flex:0 0 auto;animation:income-stream var(--duration,105s) ease-in-out infinite alternate;will-change:transform}
.income-wall-row:nth-child(even){animation-direction:alternate-reverse}
.income-wall-tile{width:clamp(195px,19vw,310px);height:114px;flex:0 0 auto;padding:0;background:#131316;border:1px solid #7a3941;overflow:hidden;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #0006,0 6px 18px #00000030;pointer-events:none;cursor:zoom-in;transition:border-color .2s,filter .2s}
.income-wall-tile img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain;filter:grayscale(.05) contrast(1.18) brightness(.95) saturate(1.02)}
.income-wall-tint{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#050505c8 0%,#05050598 18%,#05050570 50%,#05050598 82%,#050505c2 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,#05050578,#05050538 46%,#05050578);pointer-events:none}
@keyframes income-stream{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(calc(-100% + 105vw))}}
@keyframes income-vertical{from{transform:translateY(45px) rotate(-3.5deg) scale(1.13)}to{transform:translateY(-320px) rotate(-3.5deg) scale(1.13)}}
.wall-explore-button{position:relative;z-index:3;display:block;margin:0 34px 21px auto;background:#181013e8;color:#fff;border:1px solid #a42736;border-radius:4px;padding:10px 16px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;transition:background .2s}
.wall-explore-button span{color:var(--red);font-size:16px;margin-left:8px}
.wall-explore-button:hover{background:#300c15}
.screen--case.wall-explore .income-wall{z-index:2;pointer-events:auto}
.screen--case.wall-explore .income-wall-tint{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#05050599,#0505052c 45%,#050505a0);pointer-events:none}
.screen--case.wall-explore .income-wall-row{animation-play-state:paused}
.screen--case.wall-explore .income-wall-tracks{animation:none;transform:translateY(var(--wall-pan-y,-120px)) rotate(-3.5deg) scale(1.13)}
.screen--case.wall-explore .income-wall-tile{pointer-events:auto}
.screen--case.wall-explore .income-wall-tile:hover{border-color:var(--red);filter:brightness(1.4)}
.screen--case.wall-explore .income-wall-tracks{cursor:grab}
.screen--case.wall-explore .income-wall-tracks:active{cursor:grabbing}
.screen--case.wall-explore > .shell{filter:blur(2px);opacity:.18;pointer-events:none}
.screen--case.wall-explore > .wall-explore-button{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;border-color:#fff;background:#bd1023;box-shadow:0 9px 32px #000e}
.screen--case .case-head,.screen--case .case-showcase,.screen--case .story-content{filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 6px #000)}
.screen--case .story-content{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#050505d2 0%,#050505b5 80%,transparent);padding-right:14px}
.screen--case .case-showcase figure{background:#080808bf}
.screen--case .case-metric--income{background:#0505058c!important}
@media(max-width:800px){
 .screen--case .income-wall{inset:67px 0 78px}
 .income-wall-tracks{gap:10px;inset:-28px -25%;transform:rotate(-5deg) scale(1.12)}
 .income-wall-tile{width:210px;height:94px}
 .income-wall-tint{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#050505e2,#050505b4 49%,#050505e3),linear-gradient(180deg,#05050599,#05050544,#050505a0)}
 .wall-explore-button{margin:0 20px 17px auto;max-width:calc(100% - 40px);font-size:9px}
 .screen--case .story-content{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#050505dc,#050505be);padding-right:8px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.income-wall-row,.income-wall-tracks{animation:none!important}}


/* YGO — продуктовая страница: маршрут, программа, тарифы */
.ygo-program{padding-bottom:70px}
.program-intro{max-width:940px;margin:0 0 54px}
.program-title{font-size:clamp(39px,5.3vw,70px);margin:16px 0 24px!important;max-width:1080px}
.program-lead{font-size:clamp(16px,1.65vw,21px);line-height:1.8;color:#e0dfe0;max-width:870px;margin:16px 0}
.program-lead--sub{font-size:14px;color:#aaaaaf;max-width:810px}
.program-target{margin-top:31px;border-top:1px solid #5d2028;border-bottom:1px solid #5d2028;padding:18px 0 22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:155px 210px 1fr;gap:24px;align-items:center}
.program-target span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--red);font-weight:800}
.program-target strong{font-size:clamp(35px,4.3vw,53px);letter-spacing:-.07em;color:white;line-height:1}
.program-target p{margin:0;color:#bebdc1;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;max-width:450px}
.program-section{margin:0 0 66px}
.program-section-heading{margin-bottom:24px;max-width:820px}
.program-section-heading h3{font-size:clamp(29px,3.4vw,44px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.06em;line-height:1.2;margin:9px 0 8px}
.program-section-heading p{color:#a9a9ae;font-size:14px;max-width:710px;line-height:1.85;margin:13px 0 0}
.program-roadmap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.program-step{background:#101011;border:1px solid #313034;padding:21px 18px 25px;min-height:260px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.program-step > span{color:var(--red);font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:28px}
.program-step h4{font-size:17px;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:0 0 12px}
.program-step p{font-size:12px;color:#a3a3a8;line-height:1.85;margin:0}
.program-topics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.program-topic{padding:28px 28px 24px;background:#101011;border:1px solid #2f2f32}
.program-topic-number{color:var(--red);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;margin-bottom:12px}
.program-topic h4{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:0 0 17px}
.program-topic ul,.program-tier ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.program-topic li{padding:9px 0 9px 20px;border-top:1px solid #29292d;color:#c8c8cc;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;position:relative}
.program-topic li:before{content:'+';position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--red);font-weight:800}
.program-tiers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.program-tier{background:#0e0e10;border:1px solid #36363a;padding:26px 24px 25px;min-height:370px}
.program-tier--accent{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1c0a0e,#101012 57%);border-color:#8c1c2b}
.program-tier-index{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--red);font-weight:800}
.program-tier h4{font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:1.2;margin:20px 0 12px}
.program-tier-text{font-size:12px;color:#a7a7ae;line-height:1.85;min-height:68px;margin:0 0 21px}
.program-tier li{padding:11px 0 11px 18px;border-top:1px solid #2c2b30;position:relative;color:#e0dfe1;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
.program-tier li:before{content:'✓';position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--red);font-weight:800}
.program-bottom{padding:36px 34px;border:1px solid #8d1e2a;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#260a10,#0a0a0c 75%);display:flex;gap:35px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.program-bottom h3{font-size:clamp(25px,3.4vw,43px);max-width:680px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:10px 0}
.program-bottom p{color:#b8b8bb;font-size:13px;margin:10px 0 0}
.program-next{flex:0 0 300px}
@media(max-width:1000px){.program-roadmap{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.program-step{min-height:220px}.program-tiers{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.program-tier:last-child{grid-column:span 2}.program-tier{min-height:unset}}
@media(max-width:800px){.ygo-program{padding-bottom:45px}.program-intro{margin-bottom:39px}.program-title{font-size:clamp(34px,8.6vw,47px)}.program-lead{font-size:15px}.program-lead--sub{font-size:13px}.program-target{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:7px;padding:19px 0}.program-target strong{font-size:43px}.program-target p{font-size:12px}.program-section{margin-bottom:46px}.program-roadmap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.program-step{min-height:unset;padding:17px 19px}.program-step>span{margin-bottom:10px}.program-topics,.program-tiers{grid-template-columns:1fr}.program-tier:last-child{grid-column:auto}.program-topic{padding:23px 19px}.program-tier{padding:24px 21px}.program-tier-text{min-height:unset}.program-bottom{padding:25px 20px;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:24px}.program-next{flex:auto;width:100%}}


/* v8: simplified readable product page */
.screen--product .shell{max-width:1280px}
.ygo-product-v2{padding-bottom:72px}
.product-hero{max-width:980px;margin-bottom:28px}
.product-title{font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,68px);line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:12px 0 18px}
.product-subtitle{max-width:840px;font-size:clamp(16px,1.55vw,22px);line-height:1.7;color:#d8d8dd;margin:0}
.product-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin:0 0 28px}
.product-stat,.product-card,.product-tier,.product-cta,.product-step,.product-module{background:#0d0d0f;border:1px solid #242428;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.02) inset}
.product-stat{padding:22px 20px 20px}
.product-stat span,.product-card-kicker,.product-tier-top span,.product-module summary span,.product-step span{display:inline-block;color:var(--red);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:11px}
.product-stat strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(24px,2.2vw,35px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#fff;margin:12px 0 10px}
.product-stat p{margin:0;color:#b8b8be;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65}
.product-grid-two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:14px;margin:0 0 34px}
.product-grid-two--bottom{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.product-card{padding:26px 24px}
.product-card--accent{background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(120,13,32,.18),rgba(13,13,15,1) 45%)}
.product-card h3{font-size:clamp(26px,2.5vw,40px);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:12px 0 18px;max-width:780px}
.product-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.product-tags span{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #313136;background:#121216;border-radius:999px;color:#dedee2;font-size:13px;line-height:1.3}
.product-checklist{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:12px}
.product-checklist li{position:relative;padding-left:22px;color:#d9d9de;line-height:1.55;font-size:14px}
.product-checklist li:before{content:'✓';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;color:var(--red);font-weight:900}
.product-section{margin:0 0 38px}
.product-section-head{max-width:800px;margin-bottom:18px}
.product-section-head h3{font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,44px);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:8px 0 8px}
.product-section-head p{margin:0;color:#a8a8ae;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.product-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.product-step{padding:22px 18px}
.product-step span{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.product-step h4{font-size:21px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:18px 0 10px}
.product-step p{margin:0;color:#b7b7bd;font-size:13px;line-height:1.62}
.product-modules{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.product-module{padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.product-module summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;padding:20px 20px 18px;cursor:pointer}
.product-module summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.product-module summary span{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1;margin-top:2px}
.product-module summary h4{font-size:22px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:0 0 4px}
.product-module summary p{margin:0;color:#9f9fa6;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.product-module ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 20px 20px 56px;border-top:1px solid #202025}
.product-module li{padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid #24242a;color:#dadadf;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
.product-module li:first-child{border-top:none;padding-top:16px}
.product-tiers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.product-tier{padding:24px 22px;background:#0f0f11}
.product-tier--accent{background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(117,16,32,.28),#0f0f11 45%);border-color:#70202b}
.product-tier-top h4{font-size:27px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:14px 0 12px}
.product-tier ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.product-tier li{padding:11px 0 11px 20px;border-top:1px solid #26262b;color:#dddde1;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;position:relative}
.product-tier li:before{content:'•';position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--red);font-weight:900}
.product-cta{padding:28px 28px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:28px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(122,13,31,.22),rgba(13,13,15,1) 60%);border-color:#82202c}
.product-cta h3{font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,42px);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:10px 0}
.product-cta p{margin:0;color:#bcbcc2;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;max-width:640px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.product-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.product-steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.product-step:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}.product-tiers{grid-template-columns:1fr}.product-grid-two,.product-grid-two--bottom,.product-modules{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:760px){.ygo-product-v2{padding-bottom:44px}.product-title{font-size:clamp(32px,10vw,46px)}.product-subtitle{font-size:15px}.product-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px}.product-stat{padding:18px 16px}.product-grid-two{gap:10px;margin-bottom:24px}.product-card{padding:20px 18px}.product-card h3{font-size:27px}.product-section{margin-bottom:28px}.product-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px}.product-step:last-child{grid-column:auto}.product-step{padding:18px 16px}.product-step h4{font-size:18px;margin:14px 0 8px}.product-section-head h3{font-size:29px}.product-module summary{padding:18px 16px 16px;gap:12px}.product-module ul{padding:0 16px 18px 42px}.product-tier{padding:20px 18px}.product-tier-top h4{font-size:23px}.product-tier li{font-size:13px}.product-cta{padding:22px 18px;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:18px}.program-next{width:100%;flex:auto}}


/* v9 — interactive product tariff disclosure */
.product-reveal-page{max-width:1330px!important;padding-bottom:90px}
.reveal-heading{position:relative;text-align:center;padding:34px 0 20px}
.reveal-heading h2{font-size:clamp(52px,7.2vw,112px);letter-spacing:-.085em;line-height:1.04;margin:12px 0 20px}
.reveal-hint{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:15px;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2a0b11f0,#15090bd8);border:1px solid #7d1a27;border-radius:8px;padding:14px 20px;box-shadow:0 12px 36px #0000005a,0 0 0 1px #3a1118 inset;position:relative}
.reveal-hint-arrow{font-size:72px;line-height:.9;color:var(--red);display:inline-block;text-shadow:0 0 18px #8b1023;animation:reveal-bounce 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;position:absolute;left:12%;top:66px}
@keyframes reveal-bounce{50%{transform:translateY(7px)}}
.reveal-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin:15px auto 32px}
.reveal-option{color:#fff;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(146deg,#151517 0%,#09090a 75%);border:1px solid #36363a;border-radius:6px;text-align:left;min-height:315px;padding:28px 27px 23px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s,background .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.reveal-option:hover,.reveal-option:focus-visible{border-color:#f0182d;transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 40px #0008}
.reveal-option[aria-expanded=true]{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#320a13,#111013 70%);border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #f0182d36}
.reveal-option-kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--red);font-weight:800}
.reveal-option-title{font-size:clamp(31px,3vw,48px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.07em;font-weight:800;margin:28px 0 0}
.reveal-option-summary{display:none}
.reveal-option-bottom{margin-top:auto;padding-top:40px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;width:100%;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#fff}
.reveal-option-icon{color:white;background:var(--red);border-radius:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:40px;height:40px;font-size:24px;transition:transform .2s}
.reveal-option[aria-expanded=true] .reveal-option-icon{transform:rotate(135deg)}
.tier-panel{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#151215,#090909 45%);border:1px solid #52232b;border-radius:6px;padding:36px;margin-bottom:30px;animation:tier-appear .28s ease-out}
@keyframes tier-appear{from{opacity:.4;transform:translateY(-6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.tier-panel-heading{max-width:920px;margin-bottom:25px}
.tier-panel-label,.tier-subheading>span,.tier-baseline span{color:var(--red);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.15em}.tier-number-row>div>span{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,28px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.15}
.tier-panel-heading h3{font-size:clamp(31px,3.6vw,50px);line-height:1.17;letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:10px 0 10px}
.tier-panel-heading p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;color:#bcbcc3;max-width:790px;margin:0}
.tier-number-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin:25px 0 38px}
.tier-number-row>div{border:1px solid #353338;background:#0e0e10;padding:23px;border-radius:4px}
.tier-number-row strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(34px,3.2vw,48px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:10px 0 8px}
.tier-number-row p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#b2b2b8;margin:0}
.tier-subheading{margin:32px 0 17px}
.tier-subheading h4{font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,38px);margin:7px 0;letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:1.2}
.tier-subheading p{font-size:13px;color:#bcbcc2;margin:4px 0}
.tier-roadmap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
.tier-roadmap>div{background:#0e0e10;border:1px solid #29292d;border-radius:4px;padding:17px 15px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.tier-roadmap b{font-size:11px;color:var(--red)}
.tier-roadmap strong{font-size:24px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.tier-roadmap span{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#b6b6bd}
.tier-modules{display:block}
.tier-modules details{background:#0e0e10;border:1px solid #333338;border-radius:4px;min-width:0}
.tier-modules details[open]{border-color:#75232f}
.tier-modules summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;padding:19px 18px;cursor:pointer}
.tier-modules summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.tier-modules summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red);outline-offset:-3px}
.tier-module-num{color:var(--red);font-weight:800;font-size:16px}
.tier-module-name{flex:1;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.tier-module-name small{display:block;color:#999ba2;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0;margin-top:4px}
.tier-plus{font-size:25px;color:var(--red);transition:transform .2s}
.tier-modules details[open] .tier-plus{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.tier-modules ul{margin:0;padding:12px 18px 18px 55px;color:#c6c6cd;line-height:1.7;border-top:1px solid #2b2b30;font-size:13px}
.tier-modules li{margin:6px 0}
.tier-modules-flat{background:#0e0e10;border:1px solid #333338;border-radius:4px;padding:22px 24px}.tier-modules-flat ul{margin:0;padding-left:22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:9px}.tier-modules-flat li{font-size:15px;line-height:1.55;color:#d2d2d8}.tier-panel .tier-subheading + .tier-modules-flat{margin-top:10px}@media(max-width:690px){.tier-modules-flat{padding:18px}.tier-modules-flat li{font-size:14px}}.tier-baseline{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;margin-top:32px;padding:22px 25px;border-left:3px solid var(--red);background:#1b0f12}
.tier-baseline>div{flex:1}
.tier-baseline h4{font-size:20px;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:7px 0 0}
.tier-baseline p{flex:1;max-width:510px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#c2b9bd;margin:0}
.tier-feature-list{display:grid;gap:12px;margin:28px 0}
.tier-feature-list>div{display:flex;gap:23px;background:#0e0e10;border:1px solid #303035;border-radius:4px;padding:25px}
.tier-feature-mark{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--red);line-height:1.2}
.tier-feature-list h4{font-size:clamp(28px,2.4vw,34px);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:0 0 7px}
.tier-feature-list p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#b8b8be;margin:0;max-width:800px}
.tier-forwhom{border-top:1px solid #383136;border-bottom:1px solid #383136;padding:34px 0 36px;margin-top:38px}
.tier-forwhom h3{font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,68px);letter-spacing:-.08em;line-height:1;margin:0 0 10px;color:#fff}
.tier-forwhom p{font-size:clamp(12px,1.4vw,14px);line-height:1.45;max-width:1080px;color:#cfcfd4;margin:0}
.tier-forwhom-tags{display:none}
.tier-forwhom-tags span{display:none}
.reveal-next{width:100%;max-width:450px;margin:25px 0 0}
@media(max-width:1000px){.tier-roadmap{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.reveal-option{padding:23px 18px;min-height:290px}.reveal-option-title{font-size:clamp(28px,3.5vw,40px)}.tier-number-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.tier-number-row>div:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}
@media(max-width:690px){.product-reveal-page{padding-bottom:45px}.reveal-heading{padding:12px 0 15px}.reveal-heading h2{font-size:clamp(43px,10vw,65px)}.reveal-hint{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;gap:10px}.reveal-hint-arrow{font-size:25px}.reveal-options{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:20px}.reveal-option{min-height:140px;padding:20px 18px}.reveal-option-title{font-size:34px;margin:11px 0 2px}.reveal-option-summary{font-size:13px}.reveal-option-bottom{padding-top:12px}.reveal-option-icon{width:35px;height:35px;font-size:20px}.tier-panel{padding:19px 16px;margin-bottom:24px}.tier-panel-heading h3{font-size:30px}.tier-panel-heading p{font-size:14px}.tier-number-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:9px;margin-bottom:26px}.tier-number-row>div:last-child{grid-column:auto}.tier-number-row>div{padding:18px}.tier-roadmap,.tier-modules{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tier-roadmap>div{padding:15px}.tier-roadmap strong{font-size:16px}.tier-subheading{margin:24px 0 12px}.tier-subheading h4{font-size:25px}.tier-module-name{font-size:16px}.tier-modules summary{padding:16px 13px}.tier-modules ul{padding-left:37px}.tier-baseline{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding:17px;gap:10px;margin-top:25px}.tier-baseline h4{font-size:18px}.tier-feature-list>div{padding:19px 15px;gap:14px}.tier-feature-list h4{font-size:19px}.tier-feature-list p{font-size:13px}.tier-forwhom{margin-top:22px;padding:26px 0}.tier-forwhom p{font-size:14px}.reveal-next{max-width:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.reveal-hint-arrow{animation:none}.tier-panel{animation:none}}


/* YGO v12 — clean basic tariff and better hierarchy */
.screen--product .tier-panel-heading--basic p{
  color:#fff;font-size:clamp(17px,1.55vw,23px);line-height:1.6;font-weight:600;
  max-width:1050px;background:#201116;border-left:4px solid var(--red);
  padding:20px 24px;margin-top:18px;border-radius:0 5px 5px 0;
}
.screen--product .tier-number-row>div>span{
  color:var(--red);font-weight:850;letter-spacing:-.035em;
  font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,33px);line-height:1.13;
}
.screen--product .tier-number-row strong{
  color:#fff;font-size:clamp(25px,2.5vw,37px);line-height:1.15;
  margin:14px 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.045em;
}
.screen--product .tier-number-row p{font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,14px);line-height:1.5}
.screen--product .tier-subheading--roadmap{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:38px 0 20px}
.screen--product .tier-subheading--roadmap>span{
  color:var(--red);font-size:clamp(26px,3.25vw,49px);letter-spacing:-.065em;
  line-height:1.08;font-weight:900;
}
.screen--product .tier-subheading--roadmap h4{
  color:#fff;font-size:clamp(21px,2vw,30px);line-height:1.1;margin:0;
  letter-spacing:-.045em;font-weight:700;
}
.screen--product .tier-subheading--topics{margin:42px 0 18px}
.screen--product .tier-subheading--topics>span{
  color:var(--red);font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,53px);line-height:1.06;
  letter-spacing:-.065em;font-weight:900;
}
.screen--product .tier-roadmap{
  display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:0;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;
  padding:4px 0 12px;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;
  scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#711a28 transparent;
}
.screen--product .tier-roadmap>div{
  flex:1 0 0;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box;scroll-snap-align:start;
  padding:22px 16px;background:#0f0f12;border:1px solid #303039;
  border-radius:5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;
}
.screen--product .tier-roadmap b{font-size:16px}
.screen--product .tier-roadmap strong{font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,23px);line-height:1.2}
.screen--product .tier-roadmap span:not(.tier-step-arrow){font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#b6b6bd}
.screen--product .tier-roadmap>.tier-step-arrow{
  flex:0 0 24px;align-self:center;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--red);font-size:25px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;opacity:.98;
}
.screen--product .tier-roadmap .tier-step-six{border-color:#ac2839;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#33121a,#101013 70%)}
.screen--product .tier-modules-flat{padding:24px 30px}
.screen--product .tier-modules-flat li{font-size:clamp(14px,1.15vw,17px);line-height:1.65}
.screen--product .tier-forwhom .forwhom-y{color:var(--red)}
.screen--product .tier-forwhom p{
  max-width:1180px;font-size:clamp(21px,2.1vw,32px);
  line-height:1.46;color:#ebebef;letter-spacing:-.02em;
}
@media(max-width:1400px){
  .screen--product .tier-roadmap>div{flex:0 0 210px;}
}
@media(max-width:690px){
  .screen--product .tier-panel-heading--basic p{font-size:16px;padding:14px 15px;margin-top:14px}
  .screen--product .tier-number-row>div>span{font-size:23px}
  .screen--product .tier-number-row strong{font-size:29px}
  .screen--product .tier-subheading--roadmap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin:30px 0 16px}
  .screen--product .tier-subheading--roadmap>span{font-size:30px}
  .screen--product .tier-subheading--roadmap h4{font-size:21px}
  .screen--product .tier-subheading--topics>span{font-size:35px}
  .screen--product .tier-roadmap{flex-direction:column;overflow-x:visible;padding:0 0 8px}
  .screen--product .tier-roadmap>div{min-width:0;width:100%;flex:0 0 auto;padding:20px 18px;}
  .screen--product .tier-roadmap strong{font-size:23px}
  .screen--product .tier-roadmap>.tier-step-arrow{align-self:center;flex:0 0 30px;transform:rotate(90deg);font-size:28px}
  .screen--product .tier-modules-flat{padding:17px 16px}
  .screen--product .tier-forwhom p{font-size:23px;line-height:1.43}
}

/* Keep all six roadmap steps legible at laptop widths. */
@media(min-width:1001px){
 .screen--product .tier-roadmap>div{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0}
 .screen--product .tier-roadmap strong{font-size:clamp(15px,1.25vw,20px);overflow-wrap:anywhere;hyphens:auto}
 .screen--product .tier-roadmap>.tier-step-arrow{flex:0 0 18px;font-size:19px}
}
@media(min-width:1001px) and (max-width:1400px){
 .screen--product .tier-roadmap>div{padding:18px 12px}
 .screen--product .tier-roadmap strong{font-size:16px}
}

/* YGO v13: compact corrections */
/* Keep income metrics perfectly centered on their card */
.case-showcase figure.case-metric--income{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;flex-direction:column!important;padding:0!important;min-height:260px!important}
.case-metric--income figcaption{width:100%;margin:auto 0!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;text-align:center!important;background:transparent!important;padding:20px 15px!important}
.case-metric--income figcaption strong{width:100%;margin:0!important;display:block;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,70px)!important;line-height:1.05}
.case-metric--income figcaption span{display:block;text-align:center;max-width:100%;font-size:clamp(12px,1.3vw,16px)}
/* More prominent case gallery mode control; only the case page has this control */
.wall-explore-button{display:block!important;background:#ee1730!important;color:#fff!important;border:2px solid #ff6270!important;border-radius:8px!important;box-shadow:0 10px 35px #f0182d35,0 3px 16px #000!important;padding:17px 22px!important;font-size:clamp(12px,1.15vw,15px)!important;letter-spacing:.06em!important;line-height:1.45!important;font-weight:900!important;max-width:calc(100% - 36px)}
.wall-explore-button span{color:#fff!important;font-size:22px!important;vertical-align:middle;font-weight:900}
.wall-explore-button:hover{background:#bc0d23!important;box-shadow:0 10px 40px #f0182d65!important}
.screen--case.wall-explore > .wall-explore-button{background:#b20c22!important;border-color:#fff!important}
/* Dynamic receipt walls on all four slides; only the case version is interactive */
.screen>.income-wall{position:fixed;inset:78px 0 95px;overflow:hidden;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:#090707}
.screen>.income-wall--decorative,.screen>.income-wall--decorative *{pointer-events:none!important}
.screen>.income-wall--decorative .income-wall-tint{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#050505de 0%,#050505b5 20%,#0505058c 50%,#050505b5 80%,#050505de 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,#0505059a,#05050555 46%,#0505059a)}
.screen--case>.income-wall .income-wall-tint{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#050505c8 0%,#05050598 18%,#05050570 50%,#05050598 82%,#050505c2 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,#05050578,#05050538 46%,#05050578)}
.screen--case.wall-explore>.income-wall .income-wall-tint{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#05050599,#0505052c 45%,#050505a0)}
/* Hint aligned to first tariff, arrow is contained inside it and cannot sit on tariff 02 */
.reveal-heading{padding-bottom:22px!important}
.reveal-hint{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;width:max-content;max-width:100%;margin:18px 0 0 4%!important;gap:16px!important;color:white!important;font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,16px)!important;padding:11px 16px 11px 19px!important;border:2px solid #ed243b!important;box-shadow:0 0 20px #f0182d30!important;line-height:1.35!important}
.reveal-hint-arrow{position:static!important;display:inline-block!important;left:auto!important;right:auto!important;top:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;font-size:38px!important;line-height:1!important;flex:0 0 auto;animation:reveal-bounce 1.65s ease-in-out infinite}
.reveal-options{margin-top:17px!important}
@media(max-width:690px){
  .reveal-hint{margin-left:0!important;gap:12px!important;padding:9px 13px!important;font-size:12px!important}
  .reveal-hint-arrow{font-size:32px!important}
  .reveal-options{margin-top:13px!important}
  .wall-explore-button{font-size:11px!important;padding:12px 14px!important}
  .case-showcase figure.case-metric--income{min-height:180px!important}
  .case-metric--income figcaption strong{font-size:clamp(38px,11vw,52px)!important}
  .screen>.income-wall{inset:64px 0 64px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.income-wall-row,.income-wall-tracks,.reveal-hint-arrow{animation:none!important}}

/* Remove obsolete spacer inside the income card so the amount sits at its real center */
.case-metric--income .case-income-visual{display:none!important;height:0!important;}
</style>
